Why it is False:
This claim has been widely debunked by multiple reliable sources, including the Wisconsin Elections Commission, fact-checkers at Reuters, AP, and PolitiFact, and independent investigations. In the 2020 election, the number of ballots cast in Wisconsin did not exceed the number of registered voters. Some confusion arose because Wisconsin allows same-day voter registration, which increases the registered voter count after Election Day, but all votes cast were valid and accounted for.
